name: Component Library
description: Site-building component library: component markup lives in config-entity Twig templates (patterns + variants), authored in-browser with CodeMirror, plus an Override Mode to rewrite theme templates and attach CSS/JS. Integrates with UI Patterns, Layout Builder, Workspaces and Group.
project_description:
Component library is a way to do theming as a site-building task.

 Use CKeditor Component Library to allow you to embed your Component Library pattern variants inside ckeditor5 content.

 Now with Override Mode! Edit your twig templates and add CSS & JS right in your browser and even publish all the changes along with your workspace. Please check out the demo .
